description: On a phone the app's own copy of the web client may open a link in the browser, the mail app or the phone app, keep each server's session in the Keychain or the Keystore, sign in on a server's page in the system's sign-in sheet, read the chat-systems:// links that open it, show a notification and hear it tapped, and on Android hold a huddle in the background, and nothing else.
